none: PAS NLM-52A4A1: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), fallen horseman issue of 355-361, Reece period 18. Aggressively cleaned. Obverse description: Bust draped, diademed and possibly cuirassed right. Reverse description: Soldier advancing left spearing fallen horseman; possibly sans horse. Reverse inscription: [FEL TEMP RE]PARATIO. Diameter: 18.7mm, Weight: 1.61gms, die axis: 6
